findings.title: Selective forum pipeline
findings.claim: The warning can be read as a selective forum pipeline: wording is displaced, an acceptable portion is preselected, a judge is approached, and withdrawal follows when the desired result is unavailable.
findings.mechanism: The 5:41 carriers at words 27, 31, and 36 present redirected wording, settled places, and taking; 5:42 supplies repeated resort to judgment and 5:43 supplies withdrawal. These triggers meet the focus carriers in يَفْتِنُوكَ, the paired بَعْضِ occurrences, ٱحْكُم, and تَوَلَّوْا۟, changing the warning into a picture of extracting a favorable slice through a chosen forum.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the focus word for a part matters: it names the selected portion of a larger textual and procedural operation.
findings.containment: The plain command to judge by what Allah sent down and to beware diversion remains intact. The pipeline is an attributed contextual analogy; the packet leaves open whether the same actors perform every step.

epistemic.reason: Every cited HFT coordinate agrees with supplied context or focus evidence, while the source identity is legacy_unbound and the actor grouping is inferential.

findings.title: Small partial injury
